title: Business Travel
completion_message: ¡Buen viaje! Ya conoces el vocabulario para moverte con seguridad en tus viajes de negocios.

parts.visual: En el aeropuerto: Flight (Vuelo). Boarding pass (Pase de abordar). Gate (Puerta de embarque). Luggage / Baggage (Equipaje). Delay (Retraso). Check-in (Registrarse).
parts.audio: At the airport. Flight. Boarding pass. Gate. Luggage or Baggage. Delay. Check-in.

parts.visual: En el hotel y oficina: Reservation / Booking (Reserva). Single room (Habitación sencilla). Conference room (Sala de conferencias). Expense report (Reporte de gastos). Receipt (Recibo).
parts.audio: At the hotel and office. Reservation or Booking. Single room. Conference room. Expense report. Receipt.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para situaciones de viaje corporativo.

questions.question: I am going on a business ____ next week. (Viaje).
What time is your ____ to London? (Vuelo).
You need to show your passport and ____ pass at the gate. (Pase de abordar).
Please proceed to ____ number 5 for boarding. (Puerta).
questions.explanation: Gate = puerta de embarque en un aeropuerto.

questions.question: I only have carry-on ____. I don't need to check any bags. (Equipaje).
questions.explanation: Carry-on luggage = equipaje de mano. (También se dice baggage).

questions.question: The flight is ____ by two hours due to bad weather. (Retrasado).
I need to make a hotel ____ for three nights. (Reserva).
questions.explanation: Make a reservation = hacer una reserva. (También: Make a booking).

questions.question: I would like a ____ room, please. Just for me. (Sencilla).
What time is ____ at the hotel? (Hora de salida).
questions.explanation: Check-out = hora de registro de salida.

questions.question: Remember to keep all your ____ for the company. (Recibos).
You must submit an ____ report when you return. (Reporte de gastos).
Is breakfast ____ in the room rate? (Incluido).
I need to rent a ____ at the airport. (Auto/Coche).
questions.explanation: Rent a car = alquilar/rentar un auto.

questions.question: Where is the ____ claim area? (Reclamo de equipaje).
questions.explanation: Baggage claim = reclamo de equipaje (donde recoges las maletas).

questions.question: The ____ attendant will give you instructions. (Asistente de vuelo/Sobrecargo).
Can I have an ____ seat, please? I don't like the window. (Asiento de pasillo).
questions.explanation: Aisle seat = asiento de pasillo. (Se pronuncia 'ail').

questions.question: The company pays for the ____ class tickets. (Clase ejecutiva).
We have a meeting in the ____ room on the 3rd floor. (Sala de conferencias).
Could you arrange a ____ to pick me up from the airport? (Taxi/Transporte).
questions.explanation: Arrange a taxi = organizar un taxi.

questions.question: I missed my ____ flight! (Vuelo de conexión).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de viaje correcta.

questions.question: I am on a business ____. (Viaje)
What time is your ____? (Vuelo)
Here is my ____ pass. (Pase de abordar)
Go to ____ 5. (Puerta de embarque)
Where is my ____? (Equipaje - empieza con L)
The flight is ____. (Retrasado)
I have a hotel ____. (Reserva - empieza con R)
Keep all your ____. (Recibos)
Submit an ____ report. (Reporte de gastos)
I want an ____ seat. (Pasillo)
